The evidence concerns the software product **Nano Banana.pro** (also presented as **Nano Banana** / **Nano Banana Pro**) hosted at the domain **`nanobanana.pro`**.

### Provider Identification
* **Vendor / Provider Brand:** **Nano Banana** (or **Nano Banana Pro**)
* **Operating Company / Developer:** No legal corporate entity name or individual developer is published on `nanobanana.pro` (unlike other third-party wrappers such as `nanobanana-pro.me` operated by Yuan Liu Yang or `nanobanana-pro.com` operated by Mok Kam Kuen). Instead, the service operates directly under the provider brand.

### Provider Statement & Evidence
* The official website footer explicitly identifies the provider with the copyright notice: 
  > *"© 2025 • Nano Banana All rights reserved."* (and on policy pages: *"© 2025 • nano banana pro"*).
* Official support for the site is provided via **`support@nanobanana.pro`**.
